from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,time
campaign=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
model_task="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
mr=campaign/"model_results"/f"{model_task}.json"
req=campaign/"requests"/f"{model_task}.json"
out={"request_exists":req.exists(),"result_exists":mr.exists()}
if mr.exists():
    try:
        env=json.loads(mr.read_text())
        out["result_status"]=env.get("status")
        out["checkpoint"]=env.get("checkpoint")
        cp=campaign/env.get("checkpoint","")
        out["checkpoint_exists"]=cp.exists()
        if cp.exists():
            for n in ("TASK.json","WORKER.json","COMPLETE.json","events.jsonl"):
                out[n]= (cp/n).exists()
            if (cp/"WORKER.json").exists():
                w=json.loads((cp/"WORKER.json").read_text())
                out["worker_model"]=w.get("model")
                out["worker_state"]=w.get("state")
            if (cp/"COMPLETE.json").exists():
                c=json.loads((cp/"COMPLETE.json").read_text())
                out["complete_task_id"]=c.get("task_id")
                out["complete_timestamp"]=c.get("timestamp")
    except Exception as e:
        out["result_error"]=type(e).__name__+":"+str(e)
print("E118_R4_STATUS "+json.dumps(out,separators=(",",":"),default=str),flush=True)
if mr.exists():
    raise SystemExit(0)
raise SystemExit(20)
